label: Bible Study
prompt: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the _____ is servant to the lender.
verse: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
note: The plain economics of debt, written about three thousand years before credit cards.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his _____, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
verse: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
note: Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders leaves them in the best hands: God and the word of His grace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the number of them that _____, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verse: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
note: God's strange recruiting test: the three hundred who lapped water from their hands made Gideon's army.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a _____ between me and death.
verse: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
note: David to Jonathan with Saul's spear still in mind: one step between me and death.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which _____ not persons, nor taketh reward:
verse: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
note: The great, mighty, terrible God 'regardeth not persons' — no favoritism, no bribes. Peter learned it again in Acts 10:34.
